d:
"This is a companion piece featuring Safi as the substitute teacher and Jessy, her young mare student, to go along with the extremely sexy short story done by Donker." - Artist

"Jessy seems to enjoy her new wicked substitute~

Hey guys! This story is a project I wrote for my favorite artist wickedstar. It features my character Jessy, the young horse mare, and his character Safi the gazelle. A lot of you wanted to see more of Jessy aswell, so I hope you like this story as much as I did when writing it!

I am also very excited to announce that wickedstar agreed to make a companion image for this story! So you will see a depiction of one of the scenes in the story. If you are not familiar with his work, I highly recommend you check out his work." - Writer
